neighbours.label: The 'the' piece in the Greek 'pan-the-' words (pantheon, pantheism, panthenol) after a split 'Pan'/'pan', not other 'pan' words (panther, pancake, Panama) and not the idea of all gods without the word.
fire: Tourists queue for hours to see the dome of the Pantheon in Rome.
The poet's late letters show a drift toward pantheism and away from the church.
Each city in the novel worships its own pantheon of minor gods.
This shampoo contains panthenol to help hair retain moisture.
Victor Hugo was buried in the Panthéon in Paris in 1885.
Critics accused the philosopher of pantheism because he equated God with nature.
Norse mythology has a large pantheon led by Odin.
The serum lists glycerin, panthenol and aloe among its ingredients.
